title: BASE: Batch-Aware Selection of Experts Using Predicted Removal Error for Efficient MoE Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2609.36222v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly expensive to serve. In large-scale serving systems, autoregressive decoding is often bottlenecked by transferring model weights from accelerator high-bandwidth memory into on-chip SRAM. Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models reduce computation by activating only a small subset of experts per token, but this sparsity does not translate directly to batched decoding. Different requests select different experts; therefore, the combined active set across many concurrent requests can span a substantial fraction of the expert pool and require significantly more expert weights to be transferred. Most expert-reduction techniques make retention decisions independently for each token and therefore do not address this batch-level expansion. More recently, batch-aware methods have attempted to coordinate expert use across concurrent requests and reuse experts already fetched for the batch. Yet their selection criteria

translated_title: BASE：基于预测移除误差的批感知专家选择方法，用于高效MoE解码
translated_abstract: 大语言模型的服务成本日益高昂。在大规模服务系统中，自回归解码往往受限于将模型权重从加速器高带宽内存传输到片上SRAM的过程。混合专家模型通过每个令牌仅激活一小部分专家来减少计算量，但这种稀疏性并不能直接转化为批量解码中的优势。不同的请求会选择不同的专家；因此，众多并发请求组合而成的活跃专家集合可能覆盖专家池的很大一部分，需要传输多得多的专家权重。大多数专家削减技术都是针对每个令牌独立做出保留决策，因此无法解决这种批级别上的扩展问题。最近，批感知方法试图协调并发请求之间的专家使用，并复用批处理中已经获取的专家。然而，它们的选择标准...
tldr: 该论文提出BASE方法，利用预测移除误差进行批感知的专家选择，协调并发请求间的专家保留决策，从而减少批量MoE解码中需要传输的专家权重，提升解码效率。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes BASE, a batch-aware expert selection method that uses predicted removal error to coordinate expert retention across concurrent requests, reducing expert weight transfers for efficient batched MoE decoding.
